high_level_description: The image shows a large signboard for Meta, the company formerly known as Facebook. The sign is prominently displayed against a backdrop of green trees and a clear blue sky, suggesting a sunny day. The signboard is divided into two sections: the top section is white with a large blue infinity symbol (an "∞") in the center, which is the logo of Meta. Below the logo, the word "Meta" is written in white text on a black background. The bottom section of the signboard also has a black background with white text that reads "1 Hacker Way.
